collections_window_check.name: collections_window_check
collections_window_check.value: "collections"."starts_at" is null or "collections"."ends_at" is null or "collections"."ends_at" > "collections"."starts_at"

variant_constituents_value_check.name: variant_constituents_value_check
variant_constituents_value_check.value: "variant_constituents"."value_bp" >= 0 and "variant_constituents"."value_bp" <= case when "variant_constituents"."key" = 'kcal' then 9000 else 10000 end

points_ledger_sign_check.name: points_ledger_sign_check
points_ledger_sign_check.value: ("points_ledger"."kind" IN ('earn', 'bonus') AND "points_ledger"."delta" > 0) OR ("points_ledger"."kind" IN ('redeem', 'donate') AND "points_ledger"."delta" < 0) OR "points_ledger"."kind" IN ('reversal', 'adjust')

discount_codes_value_check.name: discount_codes_value_check
discount_codes_value_check.value:
("discount_codes"."kind" = 'percent' AND "discount_codes"."value" BETWEEN 1 AND 100)
        OR ("discount_codes"."kind" = 'fixed' AND "discount_codes"."value" > 0)
        OR ("discount_codes"."kind" = 'free_shipping' AND "discount_codes"."value" = 0)

discount_codes_window_check.name: discount_codes_window_check
discount_codes_window_check.value: "discount_codes"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "discount_codes"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "discount_codes"."ends_at" > "discount_codes"."starts_at"

wishlists_owner_check.name: wishlists_owner_check
wishlists_owner_check.value: ("wishlists"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "wishlists"."guest_token" IS NULL) OR ("wishlists"."user_id" IS NULL AND "wishlists"."guest_token" IS NOT NULL)
